questions.text: Tell us about a time you got away with something you absolutely should have been caught for.
What's the story behind the worst haircut you've ever had, and is there photographic evidence?
Tell us about a time you walked into completely the wrong room, house, car, or event.
What's the kindest thing a total stranger has ever done for you?
What's the most valuable thing you've ever lost, and did it ever turn up?
What's the strangest thing you've ever found — in a wall, a couch, a second-hand book, a parking lot?
Tell us about a time you stayed weirdly calm in a situation where you had every right to panic.
When were you last publicly wrong about something, and how gracefully did you handle it?
What went catastrophically wrong on one of your first days at a job?
Have you ever met someone famous, or nearly? Tell it properly, including the part where you embarrassed yourself.
Tell us about the worst navigation decision you've ever made, before or after GPS existed.
What's your dumbest injury, and what were you doing when it happened?
What's your closest call — the moment you look back on and think, that could have gone very differently?
What's a lie you told that spiralled way further than you meant it to?
Which teacher, coach, or boss said something to you that you still think about years later?
What's a night out that started completely normally and ended somewhere unrecognisable?
Tell us about a time a vehicle failed you at the worst possible moment.
What's the best or worst neighbour story you have?
What's the strangest wrong number, misdirected text, or misfired email you've been part of?
What's the weirdest delivery, package, or piece of mail that has ever arrived at your door?
What's the story your family tells at every gathering, and are you the hero or the cautionary tale in it?
What elaborate scheme did you cook up as a kid, and how far did it actually get?
What's the most expensive thing you've ever broken, and did you confess?
When did you last do something that genuinely deserved applause and got none? Take your applause now.
Tell us about the time you were tech support for someone who did not want to be helped.
What's your go-to embarrassing story — the one you can tell now without wanting to sink into the floor?
When did saying yes to something you nearly declined completely change your week, month, or year?
What's something you said no to that you're still quietly proud of?
Tell us about a time you stood up to someone in public. Did it work out?
What's the strangest thing you've ever been asked to do at work with a straight face?
When were you most lost, and how did you find your way back?
What's your best story about an animal that had no business being where it was?
What's the worst storm, heat, cold, or weather event you've lived through, and what do you remember most?
What's your worst airport, train station, or long-haul travel story?
Tell us about a repair or DIY project that went badly enough to become a story.
When did you surprise a room full of people with something they had no idea you could do?
Have you ever been mistaken for someone else, and how long did you let it go on?
What's the most money you've ever found, and what did you do with it?
What's the most important thing you've ever completely forgotten about until it was too late?
What's your worst group project, team, or shared-responsibility horror story?
What's the strangest competition or contest you've ever entered, and how did you place?
What's the best thing you've ever overheard from strangers in public?
Tell us about the moment you changed your mind about something big.
Have you ever genuinely helped someone out of a bad spot? What happened?
What's the worst advice you have ever been given, and did you take it?
What's the most important thing you have ever been late for?
What was your first live show or event, who took you, and how did it go?
What's the story of how you met the online friend you've known the longest?
